text:
Ravi (design): quick design check on the rollout inline-edit pattern. trying to surface "Ramp 3%" as a compact token that expands inline for exact controls. want feedback on clarity + a11y.
Nora: compact token is clean. question: does the expanded state push layout or overlay? pushing can shift context for keyboard users.
Ravi (design): overlay anchored to the token so layout doesn't jump. will move focus into the overlay when opened.
Zoe: overlay sounds better. accessibility: ensure overlay is reachable by keyboard and has aria-modal semantics. announce the allocation change when applied with aria-live.
Kai: copy nit: use "Ramp" as the visible token and in the overlay header say "Staged rollout (Ramp)". tooltip for newcomers: "Gradually shift traffic to a new version".
Nora: also add undo toast after apply. toast should be focusable and include aria-live=polite.
Ravi (design): rollback affordance idea: show a lightweight rollback chevron on hover of timeline nodes and expose the same action in the token overlay for parity. keyboard users get it from the kebab menu.
Zoe: confirmation modal for rollback should avoid alarmist wording. suggested: "Re-route traffic to this version. This will change live responses but not delete historical data." require a short reason only for >25% changes.
Kai: perf callout: hovering nodes currently fires metric requests. debounce 200ms and return a cached sparkline immediately.
stage-bot: preview available at https://console.redwood.ai/preview/ux/inline-ramp :white_check_mark:
Ravi (design): thanks. next steps: Zoe to add aria attributes and live-region announcements, Kai to debounce/fetch cache, Nora to write toast & undo copy. I'll push updated comps to Figma and run a final a11y pass.
Nora: i'll validate color contrast on the 3% badge at small sizes. might need a darker text token or subtle background.
Ravi (design): awesome, aiming to land this in the next sprint. :seedling:
